message.content:
Sure! To determine your friend's MBTI, I’ll need the array of personality trait percentages. Please provide it in this format:

```json
[
  {"trait": "TraitName1", "percentage": 70},
  {"trait": "TraitName2", "percentage": 30}
]
```

Once you share those details, I can calculate the MBTI for you.
